title: Add Traffic Fanout Congestion Ambassador Guard
author: Arjun Patel
description: Motivation: Intermittent tail-latency regressions were traced to high fanout requests that create queuing on downstream replicas. Existing canary signals monitor overall latency/throughput but do not capture multi-replica fanout congestion patterns. This PR introduces a lightweight 'Traffic Fanout Congestion Ambassador' guard to detect early downstream queueing caused by high fanout degree and to automatically pause or fallback rollouts when appropriate. Changes: 1) Runtime instrumentation: emit per-request fanout_degree, per-route queueing_ms histogram, and a transient congestion_score (0..1) derived from fanout_degree, backlog_ratio and KV-cache hit rate. 2) Canary evaluator plugin: stratifies by request_size and cache_hit boolean, computes congestion_score distributions for control and candidate cohorts, and evaluates a sample-weighted congestion delta using a bootstrap confidence interval. 3) Rollout guard policy: if congestion delta exceeds configured_threshold and tail queueing percentiles exceed SLO_delta the guard will pause the canary and route affected traffic to a fallback model variant. 4) Config and feature flag: perf.fanout_ambassador (disabled by default) with tunable thresholds, cooldown, and sample windows. 5) Observability: Prometheus metrics (fanout_degree_summary, congestion_score_bucket, ambassador_trigger_count), Grafana dashboard panels, and alert rule templates. 6) Tests and benchmarks: unit tests for the congestion scorer, integration harness that simulates downstream slowdown with deterministic seed, and a perf microbench to measure metric emission overhead. Backwards compatibility: additive instrumentation disabled by default; no breaking changes. Deployment plan: enable the guard in the canary pipeline on 1% of traffic for two weeks while tuning thresholds using synthesized fanout bursts, then expand to 10% and full rollout if stable. Related: ENG-2314 (canary signal expansion), ENG-2379 (rollout guard policy framework). Checklist: - [x] Implement congestion scorer and evaluator plugin - [x] Add configs + feature flag - [x] Add Prometheus metrics and dashboards - [x] Add unit/integration tests - [x] Update canary pipeline to consume guard outcome - [x] Document config in runbook.

review_comments: Sophie Wallace: Please add a short note in the docs about expected metric cardinality and suggested retention (avoid high-cardinality tags on fanout_degree).
Kenji Mori: The significance test looks good; prefer a bootstrap-based CI to be robust to non-normal distributions. Also prefer naming metric 'fanout_degree_summary' for clarity.
Liam O'Connor: Integration test intermittently flakes in CI; increase simulated downstream delay jitter and add deterministic seed for the load generator.
Author (Arjun): addressed metric name, implemented bootstrap CI in evaluator, increased jitter and pinned seed in integration test, added retention note to runbook.
release_notes: Add 'Traffic Fanout Congestion Ambassador' guard to detect downstream queueing from high fanout and pause/fallback canaries. Disabled by default; enable with perf.fanout_ambassador and tune thresholds.
